name: OpenAI Deep Research
leads: OpenAI's docs list 2026-07-23 as the shutdown date for the o3-deep-research API model. Check what replaced it (deep research in ChatGPT / newer API model) and whether the product row needs a lifecycle change or just a desc update.

cells.desc: Cross-listing: OpenAI Deep Research, launched Feb-2025 inside ChatGPT, is OpenAI's flagship long-horizon research agent (o3 base model). Distinct from the OpenAI Codex / Computer Use rows because the focus is web-research + multi-step synthesis. Available to Pro / Plus / Team / Enterprise users. The separate API models o3-deep-research and o4-mini-deep-research were retired on 2026-07-23, with gpt-5.6-sol as OpenAI's recommended replacement.

name: Gemini CLI memory (save_memory / GEMINI.md)
leads: Gemini CLI docs reportedly say it was replaced by Antigravity CLI for unpaid-tier users on 2026-06-18. Confirm; lifecycle (deprecated with successor?) or desc note.

cells.desc: Google's open-source Gemini CLI persists facts by editing tiered Markdown memory files — repo GEMINI.md, a per-project private memory folder and global ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md — that load into hierarchical context each session. Traction: Google first-party; Gemini CLI is one of the most-used terminal coding agents. On 2026-06-18 Google replaced Gemini CLI with Antigravity CLI for free, Google One and Google AI Pro/Ultra users; Gemini CLI stays supported for Gemini Code Assist Standard/Enterprise licenses and paid Gemini or Agent Platform API keys.

cells.pricing: No free tier; Code Assistant $39/user/mo, Agentic Platform $59/user/mo (annual); Headless Agents add-on $1.2k–5k/mo

name: Windsurf (now Devin Desktop)

cells.desc: Codeium-built agentic IDE (VS Code fork); flagship was Cascade, a planning + execution agent that maintains "Flows" and "Memories" as durable artifacts. Reported acquired by OpenAI in May 2025 for ~$3B (later partly unwound; Google paid ~$2.4B for an inverse-license + key staff; the remaining IDE/IP went to Cognition in July 2025). Renamed Devin Desktop by Cognition on 2026-06-02, with Devin Local replacing Cascade as the primary local agent.
cells.funding: Codeium $150M Series C (2024); ~$3B reported OpenAI offer; ultimately $2.4B Google reverse-acqui-hire (2025-07)
cells.pricing: Free $0; Pro $20/mo; Max $200/mo; Teams $80/mo plus $40/mo per full seat; Enterprise custom
